// The words that differ between hosts (Codex design 2.1). Pure: it imports nothing.
// A core text names a host word only through HOST, so each host renders its own words.

/** The words that differ between hosts. The Codex bundle swaps this file for codex/src/host.ts. */
export type Host = {
  name: string // the host, as texts say it
  command: string // the command a person types at an idle prompt
  anytime: string // the command a person runs at any time, also during a turn
  config: string // where options come from, in the report: 'from {config}'
  child: string // the report label of nested unattended runs, 15 characters at most
  resume: string // the command that picks up an unattended run, before its id
  keepOpen: string // the end of 'To keep a reserve until the reset, {keepOpen}.'
  limitOff: string // the end of 'To let work run past the limit, {limitOff}.'
  backIt: string // what Stop here does with a held prompt, tell mode
  backPrompt: string // what Stop here does with a held prompt, hold mode
  blind: string // the blind phase detail, first sentence
  leadSimulate: string // the first words of the bad simulate reply
  leadFailed: string // the first words of the failed command reply
  stoppedAgent: string // the RESUME_TAIL sentence about a subagent that did not finish
  dialog: string // the name of the question in the asking phase line
  optIn: string // the guarded row hint under scope opt-in
  unreadSource: string // what spare10 could not read when a span source is 'unread'
}

export const HOST: Host = {
  name: 'Claude Code',
  command: '/spare10',
  anytime: '/spare10',
  config: '/config',
  child: 'claude -p',
  resume: 'claude --resume',
  keepOpen: 'set its Open reserve option to 0 in /config',
  limitOff: 'turn off Pause at the limit in /config',
  backIt: 'gives it back to you',
  backPrompt: 'gives your prompt back',
  blind: 'Claude Code reports no 5-hour quota.',
  leadSimulate: '/spare10 simulate',
  leadFailed: '/spare10',
  stoppedAgent: 'A subagent whose result says "spare10: work stopped" or "spare10: the user stopped work" did not finish.',
  dialog: 'dialog',
  optIn: 'Start with SPARE10=on to guard a run.',
  unreadSource: 'the env',
}

{
  "$schema": "https://anthropic.com/claude-code/plugin.schema.json",
  "name": "spare10",
  "version": "0.4.0",
  "description": "Keeps the last part of your 5-hour and weekly quota for you. At the reserve, spare10 holds all work and asks you whether to continue. After a Resume, it asks again at the floor, by default at 5% left. Shortly before the reset, it lets work use the reserve.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Chris Nesbitt-Smith"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/chrisns/spare10-mod",
  "repository": "https://github.com/chrisns/spare10-mod",
  "keywords": [
    "quota",
    "rate-limit",
    "circuit-breaker",
    "function-hooks"
  ],
  "types": "./types.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "reserve": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Reserve (%)",
      "description": "Keep this much of the 5-hour window for yourself. spare10 steps in when this much or less is left. 1 to 99, one decimal at most. SPARE10_RESERVE overrides it for one run.",
      "default": 10,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 99
    },
    "weeklyReserve": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Weekly reserve (%)",
      "description": "Keep this much of the weekly window for yourself. 1 to 99, one decimal at most. 0 switches the weekly guard off. SPARE10_WEEKLY_RESERVE overrides it for one run.",
      "default": 10,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 99
    },
    "lastMinutes": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Open reserve before 5-hour reset (min)",
      "description": "This many minutes before the 5-hour window resets, spare10 stops guarding the reserve and lets all work use it, because the quota refreshes soon. 0 switches this off. 0 to 299, one decimal at most. SPARE10_LAST_MINUTES overrides it for one run.",
      "default": 20,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 299
    },
    "weeklyLastHours": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Open weekly reserve before weekly reset (h)",
      "description": "This many hours before the weekly window resets, spare10 stops guarding the weekly reserve and lets all work use it. 0 switches this off. 0 to 167, one decimal at most. SPARE10_WEEKLY_LAST_HOURS overrides it for one run.",
      "default": 8,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 167
    },
    "resumeFloor": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Resume floor (%)",
      "description": "After a Resume at the 5-hour reserve, spare10 asks again when this much of the window is left. With a pause prompt, it tells the agents to wind down there. A second Resume lasts until the reset. 0 switches this off, so a Resume lasts until the reset. 0 to 99, one decimal at most. A value at or above the reserve does nothing. SPARE10_RESUME_FLOOR overrides it for one run.",
      "default": 5,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 99
    },
    "weeklyResumeFloor": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Weekly resume floor (%)",
      "description": "After a Resume at the weekly reserve, spare10 asks again when this much of the weekly window is left. With a pause prompt, it tells the agents to wind down there. 0 switches this off. 0 to 99, one decimal at most. A value at or above the weekly reserve does nothing. SPARE10_WEEKLY_RESUME_FLOOR overrides it for one run.",
      "default": 5,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 99
    },
    "pausePrompt": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Pause prompt",
      "description": "Leave empty to stop and ask you. Or write an instruction, and spare10 gives it to every agent instead of stopping. At 100% used, Pause at the limit still holds all work and asks you. SPARE10_PAUSE_PROMPT overrides it for one run.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "autoResume": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Continue at the reset",
      "description": "On: spare10 continues held and stopped work by itself when the reserve opens before the reset, or a few minutes after the reset. Stop here then means stop until then. At 100% used, Stop here never continues by itself. Off: work waits for you. SPARE10_AUTO_RESUME overrides it for one run.",
      "default": true
    },
    "limitPause": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Pause at the limit",
      "description": "On: at 100% used, spare10 holds all work. This is also true in an open reserve, after a Resume and with a pause prompt. It asks you once. With no answer, the work continues after the reset, unless Continue at the reset is off. Stop here stops the work until you type a prompt after the reset. Off: work runs into the limit, and Claude Code refuses it. Switch it off when you pay for extra usage. SPARE10_LIMIT_PAUSE overrides it for one run.",
      "default": true
    },
    "headless": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Unattended runs (-p, SDK)",
      "description": "What spare10 does inside the reserve when nobody can answer: off (watch only), prompt (tell every agent to wind down), stop (refuse tools and further requests), wait (hold, then continue at the reset). SPARE10_HEADLESS overrides it for one run.",
      "default": "off",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "prompt",
        "stop",
        "wait"
      ]
    },
    "scope": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Guarded sessions",
      "description": "all: spare10 guards every interactive session. opt-in: only runs started with SPARE10=on. SPARE10=off switches spare10 off for one run.",
      "default": "all",
      "options": [
        "all",
        "opt-in"
      ]
    },
    "badge": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Status badge",
      "description": "Show the spare10 marker at the right of the prompt footer.",
      "default": true
    }
  }
}
